test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man wants to purchase a car and for that, he checks the rating of the car on internet. He finds the ratings of (9)/(10) for comfort and (8)/(10) for resale value. Based on his requirements, he gives a weightage of 55% to comfort and 45% to resale value. Calculate the final rating of the car
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the weighted average formula to the ratings:

Weighted Rating = (Comfort Rating × Comfort Weight) + (Resale Rating × Resale Weight)

⇒ Weighted Rating = (9 × 55% + 8 × 45%) / 10

⇒ Weighted Rating = (4.95 + 3.60) / 10 = 8.55 / 10

**∴ The correct answer is 8.55/10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rating for comfort = 9/10, Weightage = 55%

Rating for resale value = 8/10, Weightage = 45%

**Formula Used:**

Final Rating = (R₁ × W₁) + (R₂ × W₂)

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Comfort
 9/10 × 55%
 
 
 Resale
 8/10 × 45%
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Final Rating
 8.55 / 10

**Calculations:**

⇒ Final Rating = (9/10 × 55/100) + (8/10 × 45/100)

⇒ Final Rating = (495/1000) + (360/1000)

⇒ Final Rating = (495 + 360) / 1000

⇒ Final Rating = 855 / 1000

⇒ Final Rating = 8.55 / 10

**∴ The correct answer is 8.55/10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

It is an average that takes into account the proportional relevance of each component. It is calculated by multiplying each value by its weight and then adding the results together. Formula: Aw = (w₁x₁ + w₂x₂) ÷ (w₁ + w₂).

Percentage Conversion

Percent literally means per hundred. To use a percentage in calculation, simply divide the percentage value by 100 (e.g., 55% = 55 ÷ 100 = 0.55).
